metadata.scenario: A client notices a discrepancy on their medical bill and calls to dispute the charges. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, my name is Michael Brown. I'm calling because I noticed a discrepancy on my father's medical bill. I'm sorry to hear that, Michael. Can you tell me more about the issue you're facing? Yes, I see charges for wound care that seem higher than what was quoted to me. It's quite concerning. I understand how that can be frustrating. Let me look into that for you. Can I have your father's full name? Sure, it's Robert Brown. He has been receiving wound care and medication management services. Thank you, Michael. Just a moment while I pull up his account. *[pause]* Alright, I see the billing details here. It looks like there was a charge for two additional visits that were not included in the original estimate. Two additional visits? That's unexpected. I thought we agreed on a specific schedule. I understand. It might have been due to extra care needs that arose during those visits. But nobody informed me about extra visits. I want to dispute these charges. Of course, I can help you with that. We can initiate a billing review process. What does that involve? We’ll review the treatment notes and the billing statement, and I'll communicate with our billing department. How long will that take? Typically, it takes about 5-7 business days. Would that be acceptable for you? Yes, that works, but I want to ensure I get updates. Absolutely, I'll have someone contact you with updates on the review process. Also, while I'm on the line, can you tell me about additional services for my father? Certainly! We offer diabetes management as well, which could be beneficial. What does that involve and how much does it cost? The diabetes management service includes blood sugar monitoring and education, priced at $70-$85 for a 45-60 minute session. That sounds like something he'd need. Can we set that up? Yes, I can help with that. Would you like me to connect you with our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen? Yes, please. That would be great. Alright, I'll transfer you to Lisa. And I’ll follow up on the billing dispute as well. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help. You’re welcome, Michael. One moment while I connect you to Lisa. *[transfer sound]* Here you go, Michael. *[waiting for the transfer]*
